_doc: Maru's runtime eyeballs (AAnimalActor::MakeEyes, docs/animals.md 'Eyes'): set by hand on close-ups (unreal/scripts/test_animals.sh ANIMTEST_PART=eyes) where the generated head's own eyes are; in her frame (UE cm, +x forward, +y her right). They replace the eyeballs build_animal.py joins into the body (hidden at run time); import_animals.py bodies copies this into animal_bodies.json.
